description: This file defines utility functions for creating and handling schemas using the @sinclair/typebox library, specifically targeting string enums, optional string enums, and schema definitions for channel targets and channel target arrays.

methods.name: export function stringEnum<T extends readonly string[]>( stringEnum
methods.description: Creates a string enum schema with optional description, title, and default value, handling different input forms and ensuring compatibility with schema providers.

methods.name: export function optionalStringEnum<T extends readonly string[]>( optionalStringEnum
methods.description: Wraps stringEnum to produce an optional string enum schema, allowing the value to be omitted.

methods.name: export function channelTargetSchema(options?: { description?: string }) { channelTargetSchema
methods.description: Returns a string schema representing a channel target with an optional custom description.

methods.name: export function channelTargetsSchema(options?: { description?: string }) { channelTargetsSchema
methods.description: Returns an array schema of channel targets, each represented by channelTargetSchema, with optional description customization.
